clips.title: The story
paras: The Warpwood Quarter encompasses the eastern district of the ruined Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas, now known as Dire Maul. Once a center of elven nature cultivation and lush gardens, it has devolved into a warped, demon-tainted ruin overrun by frenzied flora and corrupted satyrs.

Formerly known for its grand botanical marvels, the Warpwood Quarter has become a choking forest of twisted ancients and lethal lashers. The district fell under the sway of Alzzin the Wildshaper, a satyr who bent his dark magic toward defiling the ancient Fruit of Fertility. Under his malign influence, the plant life grew grotesque and predatory, saturating the halls with vile Felvine shards and drawing demons, rebellious imps, and demonic thralls into the ruined halls.

While explorers typically enter the district through the central Broken Commons of Dire Maul, an overgrown subterranean backdoor lies hidden beneath the Lariss Pavilion to the east. Navigating the district requires contending not only with Alzzin's warped guardians, but also with elusive denizens such as the mischievous imp Pusillin, whose thievery leads pursuers on dangerous chases toward the secluded reaches of the ruins.
